accordingly, have no proxy votes to report:

        Evergreen VA Core Bond Fund
        Evergreen VA Strategic Income Fund

Registrant, during the reporting period. (Each fund's proxy voting record is
included below.)

                12/5/03)
        Evergreen VA Capital Growth Fund (merged into Evergreen VA Growth
                and Income Fund on 12/5/03)
        Evergreen VA Global Leaders Fund (merged into Evergreen VA

        Evergreen VA Masters Fund (merged into Evergreen VA Fund on
                12/5/03)

        Evergreen VA Equity Index Fund (liquidated on 12/23/03)
